records.name: Vue UAccordion
records.surface: UAccordion provides $pcAccordion and owns selection state. createBaseAccordion declares value (String, Number or readonly unknown[], undefined), multiple (false) and selectOnFocus (false). A prop watcher synchronizes d_value; updateValue toggles single or multiple selection and emits update:value, then tab-open or tab-close with {originalEvent: undefined, index: newValue}; index is a value, not position. Default slot composes the separate panel, header and content entries. accordionStyleModule is publicly exported and shared by all four base factories; its local dt() CSS and class keys root, panel, header, toggleicon, contentRoot and content support cx. Factories return Options API components extending createBaseComponent, which registers component styles on mount. No Prime parity judgment is implied. No direct UIX style-module import or component-metadata record exists for this scoped family.

records.name: Vue UTabs
records.surface: UTabs, UTabList, UTab, UTabPanels and UTabPanel are public compositions with createBaseTabs. Its props are value (String or Number, undefined), lazy (false), scrollable (false), showNavigators (true), tabindex (0), selectOnFocus (false). UTabs provides $pcTabs, synchronizes local d_value and emits update:value on a changed selection. UTab requires value, accepts disabled (false), exposes role=tab, aria-selected/disabled and roving tabindex; ArrowRight/Left wrap among eligible tabs, Home/End focus boundaries, PageUp/Down scroll boundaries, Enter/Space/NumpadEnter activate; focus activates only when selectOnFocus. UTabList provides role=tablist, prev/next scroll buttons, a measured ink bar, and manages a ResizeObserver. UTabPanel requires value and uses role=tabpanel with v-show; panels stay mounted even when lazy is true. UTabPanels wraps the default slot. scrollable is declared but not consulted in the current list implementation. tabsStyleModule is source-only local CSS/classes; no independently exported types or part factories. Factories return Options API components extending createBaseComponent, which registers component styles on mount. No Prime parity judgment is implied. No direct UIX style-module import or component-metadata record exists for this scoped family.

records.name: Vue UStepper
records.purpose: Compound horizontal and vertical step navigation.
records.surface: UStepper, UStepList, UStep, UStepItem, UStepPanels and UStepPanel are public compositions; createBaseStepper declares value (String or Number, undefined) and linear (false). UStepper provides $pcStepper, syncs d_value and emits update:value on change. UStepList registers children and refreshes separators. UStep requires value and accepts disabled (false); its disabled expression is !active && (linear || disabled), so active stays enabled and linear blocks non-active headers. UStep has role=tab with native button behavior; no explicit arrow-key handler. UStepItem requires value and provides vertical grouping. UStepPanel requires value, stays mounted with v-show, and exposes default scoped slot {active, activateCallback}; callback invokes updateValue without linear gating. UStepPanels wraps its default slot. UStepperSeparator is internal, not a barrel export; stepperStyleModule is source-only. No named part factories or public interfaces are declared. Factories return Options API components extending createBaseComponent, which registers component styles on mount. No Prime parity judgment is implied. No direct UIX style-module import or component-metadata record exists for this scoped family.

records.name: Vue USteps
records.surface: USteps is model-driven fixed nav/ol markup, without slots. createBaseSteps declares model (readonly unknown[], default []), readonly (true), activeStep (0). Model fields used are label, url, visible, disabled and command; there is no exported model interface. d_activeStep mirrors the prop and click never mutates it: consumers own selection. Enabled non-readonly clicks emit select {originalEvent, item, index}, then invoke item.command with the same payload; readonly or disabled clicks are blocked. Numbers use original model indices even for hidden items. ArrowRight/Left, Home and End move focus among eligible visible links without wrapping; aria-current marks the active item. stepsStyleModule is source-only local CSS/classes. Factories return Options API components extending createBaseComponent, which registers component styles on mount. No Prime parity judgment is implied. No direct UIX style-module import or component-metadata record exists for this scoped family.
